name: os common helpers
source: import { EOL, arch, availableParallelism, homedir, platform, tmpdir, type } from 'node:os'; function main(): void { console.log(typeof platform(), typeof arch(), typeof type(), tmpdir().length > 0, homedir().length > 0, availableParallelism() >= 1, EOL === '\n' || EOL === '\r\n'); }
